differences.what: the front's composition: five bays, the fanlit door in the middle, three storeys of brick over the pale basement, the entablature over the chamber storey, the attic's five short lights and the two end chimneys stand where the plate draws them (T-3721's build, on this camera: the principal heads print at 3.87 m, the chamber sills at 5.76, within about 0.1 m)

the four Ionic pilaster heads between the bays under the entablature, missing at T-3721: built (front_order.pilasters), each a bell, two volutes with their eyes, the channel and an abacus, 1.05 m across, their tops on the entablature at 7.87 m
the marble panels between the principal and chamber storeys, missing: the four plain ones under bays 1, 2, 4 and 5 and the carved one over the door built (front_order.panels)
the key blocks over the principal storey's four window lintels and over all five chamber heads, missing: built (front_order.keystones)
the scrolled marble stops at the front's corners, missing: built on brick piers at both corners (front_order.scroll); the aic scan shows the north one plainly

the gate piers: T-3721 hung the walk's gate on iron posts where the plate draws brick piers under stone caps and balls; built as brick piers 0.48 m square, caps about 2.0 m over the walk, balls 0.32 m (boundary.piers)
the pilasters' shafts: brick on brick 0.05 m proud, they read in the plate as faint vertical lines and in the render barely at all under an overcast key; their places and breadth are built

the carving of the panel over the door and of the volutes: the plate shows a carved anthemion frieze panel and true spiral volutes; built as a palmette and two rosettes in relief and as stepped discs (liberty L-k01-robbins-2126-3722), right in place, size and tone
the attic lights' eared dressings (small blocks at the heads' upper corners, about 0.25 m) are built as plain flat heads
the entablature's frieze: the plate shows veined marble slabs and a dentil course under the cornice of the attic sill; built as plain stone courses at the same heights

the sash: the plate's lights are six over six on every storey (the attic's six over six too); T-3721 built K06's two over two. T-3722: built in K06's new six-over-six sash (k06.opening.sash_6over6_flat), three lights across and two up in each sash, in the same openings and frames

the wall head: the plate's brick stops at about 11.3 m under a cornice to about 11.55 m and a thin blocking course over it, crown about 11.8 m; T-3721's K05 flat roof stood its deck on the wall head and its fascia, blocking course and coping up to 12.8 m, about 1 m over the plate's crown. T-3722: the attic storey 2.63 m (the cornice's soffit at 11.45 m) and the blocking course coped at 11.8 m (flat_crown_m), the deck dropped behind it; the stacks show about 0.7 m over it, as the plate's do

the door: the plate draws a single panelled leaf between two narrow side lights and slender posts under the door case's beam and the fanlight, in a brick arch with a stone keystone; T-3721 built K07's double leaf under a stone ring. T-3722: one pale leaf about 0.94 m across between two side lights about 0.2 m across on panels, each between pale posts about 0.1 m broad, under a moulded beam about 0.3 m deep at the spring (K07's paired side light), and the arch's ring laid in the front's brick round the stone keystone

the area: the plate's iron railing stands on a low brick wall under a stone coping, with evergreens in window boxes behind it; built as K11's spear railing on its stone curb. The boxes and shrubs are planting of the photograph's day
the flanks, the rear, the roof deck and colour: the plate is a monochrome square-on view; red brick and white marble are the register's reading
the south end: the larger scan's edge cuts close beyond the south scroll; the render's end pier and side gate on the street line at the south lot line are not shown

the door case's detail: the plate's posts are turned colonnettes with small caps and its side lights are leaded; built as flat painted posts and single panes, the case's beam stopping at the mouth's jambs where the plate's runs a little past them, the frame round the mouth and the fanlight's radial bars in the joinery's dark paint where the plate reads them pale (liberty L-k01-robbins-2126-3722)

the arch's ring: the plate's is one ring of headers round the fanlight; built as K01's voussoir block laid in the front's brick, its joints radial, the block's corners filled out to the wall's coursing

the wall head's heights: the cornice's soffit stands about 0.13 m over the plate's (11.45 m against about 11.32; K10's blocks must clear the attic lintels' heads) and the crown about 0.03 m over it (11.8 m against about 11.77)
the screen wall's pier: its cap and ball stand within about 0.05 m of the plate's; its depth behind the railing and the wall's thickness are not shown by a square-on view and are the scroll pier's
